decisions.reason: Hold this deprecated proposal because current sources leave its flow scope unresolved. This page proposes trade-ID and tracking-version matching, then a reference-ID mismatch exception. The Trade Confirmation & Cashflow STP page describes TDS3 as the universal trade-update source for FMRP and Murex. The 29 September 2026 RATAN/CDUPS interface page says BCS sends confirmation directly and TDS3 has no BCS data, but its publication field is blank. These sources do not establish whether the old CDU rule applies to BCS or conflicts with the direct CDUPS flow. Keep the complete source retained pending owner confirmation or an approved interface specification.
